Commentary.Commentary: 184 to win. Is it too much for Pakistan? Probably, on this track. But then, like Australia, they too can hope - if they get through the Powerplay without any or much damage, they can gun this down - considering that Australia's bowling options are not the strongest. Stay tuned...

Got to feel for Pakistan. What they needed in the final overs needed to be done at the start - not like they did not do it - but you cannot do much when inside edges, top edges and outside edges find the boundary. No bowler bowled badly but everyone came back well in the latter half of the innings. Does anyone remember the final over bowled by Mohammad Amir in the 2010 WT20 against Australia? He bowled a 5-wicket maiden. Today he picked up 2 wickets and conceded just 7 runs against the same opposition.

Pakistan might have sensed a comeback once Finch was dismissed. Maxwell departed early as well and the middle order did not contribute much either - which was followed by a collapse towards the end - but crucially, albeit luckily - Australia had Short at one end. He chanced his luck and ended up with 76 from 53 - with just 2 or 3 good shots from the middle of his bat. That has ensured that even though the Aussies lost wickets, the runs kept coming.

The Aussies played like there was no tomorrow - the openers concentrated on simply bashing the ball - irrespective of the length. Pakistan bowled really well, but early on, plenty of edges eluded hands and the ones that did go to hand, were not taken. Short and Finch took plenty of advantage of that, adding 95 for the opening wicket.

One look at the score - then a look at the pitch - will tell you that Australia have perhaps got enough. But did they really bat well? They have managed to rake up 183 - but it was one of those days, when you swing, keep swinging and keep swinging hard to hope that you get luck going your way - and boy, Australia were not 'SHORT' of luck today.

FOUR! A fortuitous way to start and end the innings for Australia. Jhye backs away and Amir bowls it wide outside off - the batsman slashes hard and the ball goes off the outside edge over the slip cordon to the third man fence. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 183/8!
Full toss outside off, slapped through the covers for a couple.
Jhye Richardson walks in next...

OUT! Sensational bowling from  Amir. Tye unwinds, aiming to swing this over the leg side but Amir bowls a pinpoint yorker - it is actually dipping from a full toss length - goes underneath the bat and unties Tye's stumps.
A short ball around off, Tye swings but misses.
Full toss outside off, hit down to mid off for a single.
Andrew Tye is the new man in.

OUT! Two in two for Pakistan! Well, that 190 can take a beating now. Full on middle, Head backs away and swings it cleanly - but only as far as Hasan Ali at long on! Head limps his way back to the pavilion as Pakistan gain some well-needed momentum before the break.
Jack Wildermuth walks in in the final over. How much can Australia reach? 190? Mohammad Amir to bowl.

OUT! Corker of a yorker from Hasan. Too good for the batsman. He swings early, the ball swings late. Goes under the bat even before it comes down and hits the off stump, deflecting to the third man fence. Hasan finishes with figures of 4-0-38-1 - a series to forget for him with the ball. Has not been at his best at all.
Nothing on the Free Hit. A slower ball, on a length outside off, angling away, Ashton swings but misses.

OOPS! NO BALL! Everyone is smiling barring Sarfraz and the umpire. The keeper is furious while the umpire is busy trying to signal to the batsman that the next ball will be a Free Hit. This has slipped out of the hands of Hasan Ali - clearly evident - and Agar walking across to paddle has bailed out of the shot as the ball has gone way over his head! Hasan smiles, apologizing to the batsman, who smiles back in response.
FOUR! Sensible batting. Mid off is up and Agar goes up and over - to a length ball. Not the best of bowling, with the field inside the circle. A useful boundary for Australia.
Excellent bowling. A yorker, on off, Head waits for the ball to come to him and then steers it to third man for a run.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and around off, squeezed through the covers for a single.
The physio is out in the middle, hence the delay. Travis Head is finding it difficult to run, owing to that inside edge on the side of his right knee. Meanwhile, Hasan Ali will bowl the 19th over.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple. 11 from that over, with a wicket. Australia have scored 49/3 in the last 4 overs.
Outside off, punched towards cover.
Ashton Agar walks out towards the dying stages of this innings. Australia losing some momentum.

OUT! That is a stinger! Off all the poor fielding efforts by Pakistan in the field today, this might just forgive them a bit. Full and outside off, Carey blasts this through mid off. It seems certain to beat the fielder but Shadab Khan flings himself to his right and takes it one-handed! Is this where the luck changes for Pakistan?
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off for a run.
WIDE. Miles outside off, left alone.
SIX! BLUDGEONED! A length ball, too straight, Head backs away and swings it cleanly over long on!
Gets down and looks to paddle but mistimes it onto his pads. Takes a quick single.
Faheem Ashraf is back on.
OUCH! That would have hurt. On middle and off, Head looks to pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his right knee. He is down in pain.
FOUR! This is even better! Full and outside off, Head leans and drives it wide of the diving fielder at mid off for another boundary!
FOUR! AMAZING! A full toss outside off, Head drives this behind point and gets a boundary!
Works this down the leg side for a run.
Alex Carey walks in at number 6, replacing Short.

OUT! Short's innings are over. Finally. After having luck with him for 52 balls, he falls on the 53rd. And how - spooning a simple catch to Sahibzada Farhan at cover. It was a full ball and he looked to go over the top. But... well, have to say - he has lived by the sword and died only when he has taken his team to a pretty safe total on a sluggish pitch - thanks to Lady Luck. Probably a well played is not the ideal term but he has got the runs.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Shaheen Shah Afridi is back on.
Down the leg side, flicked fine for a single. 10 from the over but look at it this way - 6 from the first ball and 4 from the next 5, which included the wicket of Stoinis.
On middle and off, watchfully defended.
Travis Head is the new man in.

OUT! Straight to the man! A high full toss, way outside off, Stoinis smashes it - but straight to Fakhar Zaman at deep point! Amir smiles, then laughs. That was not the plan at all but will anyone mind? If outside edges can go to the boundary, well, such balls deserve a wicket too, then!
A short ball, on off, Marcus tries to play the upper cut but misses.

A low full toss on off, belted down the ground past the bowler who smartly takes his foot out of the way. The ball nearly travels to the fence but Shadab Khan charges to his left from long on and dives, parrying the ball to the man running back from mid off. A couple taken.
WIDE. I think the plan was to bowl well outside off, but this has gone miles. Left alone.
SIX! A hat-trick of maximums for Australia. A short ball, on middle, Stoinis pulls this massively over mid-wicket! Immediately Sarfraz runs all the way down to the bowler to have  chat.
Mohammad Amir is back on.
SIX! This is even bigger! Hasan goes fuller and Short goes longer! Backs away and sends this sailing way over long off!!! 18 from the over, breaks the shackles.

SIX! BELLIGERENT! If my match is correct and I am not snoozing, this is the first confident shot played by Short in this innings - on the 51st ball he has faced. A length ball, on middle, Short swings this into oblivion over mid-wicket!
Punches this through mid on for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for a couple. That has been the only good thing for Australia today - running between the wickets.

Opens the face and runs it down to short third man for a quick single. That is the end of Shadab - 4-0-38-2. But that is not the way to look at it - A deeper analysis would show - 2-0-24-1 and then 2-0-14-1. A further deeper analysis would show that had there been luck on his team's side, he might have ended up with figures similar to what Billy Stanlake produced in the first meeting of the series between these two sides.

FOUR! Another edge. Tell you what - Short might well go into a casino tonight  and come out as a billionaire. He has got loads of luck. Short and outside off, he looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip region to the third man fence.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
A slip comes in now.
Full and outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
The googly, outside off, Short looks to cut but misses.
Comes down the track but is not to the pitch of the ball and is forced to defend.
Very full, on middle, Marcus looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Excellent over from Hasan - Pakistan are pulling things back.
Mid-wicket going back while fine leg comes up.

Nice shot. A short ball, around off, Stoinis initially ducks but then at the last moment, upper cuts it over the keeper. Not too much power in the stroke and third man gets to the ball. A couple taken.
Full and around off, driven powerfully but straight to mid off.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.

DROPPED! A tough chance though. Short is living on Mars, it seems and the earthly beings are finding it difficult to dislodge him. Another slice of luck. He walks down the track, looks to flick but gets a leading edge which flies to point. Shadab Khan dives to his right but is unable to hang on. Hurts his finger as well. A single taken.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Marcus Stoinis comes on to bat - AHEAD OF CAREY AND HEAD while Hasan Ali comes back on to bowl.

OUT! One wicket brings another! Shadab has struck twice in two overs. First Finch, now Maxwell. Floated on off, Maxwell backs away and swings it - but straight to Asif Ali at long on. Shadab has figures of 3-0-31-2.
Pushes this through the covers for a run this time.

Another misfield and SHORT GETS TO HIS FIFTY. An innings filled with pots of luck. He drives this through the covers and it should have been an easy single. Instead - the fielder getting across fumbles and lets it through. Two runs taken.

SAFE! Short has made it back in. He runs this down to short third man and starts to go for the single but Maxwell does not move. D'Arcy turns to go back but slips. He struggles to make it back and puts in a despairing dive. It is referred upstairs but replays show that Short has just made it in.
Run out? Is D'Arcy short? Referred upstairs...

EDGED, FOUR! Australia just keep finding these boundaries. Another googly outside off, probably on the shorter length, Short stands back to cut but gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant slip cordon to the third man fence.
The googly outside off, Short looks to run it down past the keeper but is beaten by the quicker delivery.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has dug out that yorker at the last second.
Down the leg side, Maxwell looks to flick but the ball goes off his pads to the leg side. A leg bye taken. Nope, it is a single.
A full toss outside off, sliced behind point for a couple.
On middle and leg, Short heaves it over mid-wicket. It is high in the air but does not carry to the man running in from the deep. A run taken.
On middle, Maxwell pushes it straight back to the bowler. He fumbles and the ball deflects past the stumps at the other end towards mid on. A quick single taken.
The googly, on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a run. 11 runs but the big wicket of Finch as well from the over. Shadab's figures read 2-0-24-1.
Glenn Maxwell walks in at number 3, replacing his skipper.

OUT! Pakistan have a wicket at last. And it is the big one of the Australian skipper. A short ball outside off, slowing the pace, Finch backs away and unfurls a cut shot over cover - but cannot get it over the debutant Sahibzada Farhan in the ring. The fielder leaps to take a decent catch. The 95-run stand has been broken and Pakistan can now work on the soft underbelly of a middle order for Australia.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a couple again. Mohammad Amir was the culprit this time.

Full and outside off, Aaron slogs once again, getting this down to long on. The fielder takes his own sweet time in returning the ball and the batsmen come back for the second. That should never have been two there.

SIX! BANG! 'NA NA!' Yells Sarfraz. The line is fine -  wide outside off, since Finch is backing away to the leg side - but the length is way too full. Sits nicely under the bat and goes not so nicely for Pakistan over long on. Finch moves to 43 from 24 balls. The stand is worth 91 from 56 balls.
A length ball outside off, Finch backs away and mistimes his punch back to the bowler.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for only a single. Good comeback from Afridi.
A length ball now, on middle, AF looks to pull but misses and is hit on the box. Ouch.
On middle and leg, Aaron looks to tuck it away but misses. He wants a single off the deflection from the pads but the bowler is quick to get to the ball and Finch has to go back.
On middle and leg, played with soft hands through mid-wicket for one.

A length ball down the leg side, Finch looks to tickle it fine but misses. The ball hits his pads and the batsmen take a quick run. Pakistan are lucky - fine leg was up. A bit of wood and that would have been another boundary.
Full and straight, hammered down to long on for a single.

SIX! AUDACIOUS! Floated outside off, Finch backs away, reaches out for the delivery and slogs it wayyyyy over long on for a biggie! 13 from the over, 43 from the last 3! The stand is now worth 81 from 48 balls.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Another one run down, this time straight to short third man for a quick run.
Similar ball, D'Arcy looks to play a similar shot but then withdraws his bat.

FOUR! Delicately done. Outside off, Short waits for the ball to come and then runs it down through third man. Gets it inside the man at short third man and beats him to the fence. Short moves to 40 from 28 balls with his 5th four.
Comes down the track straightaway and whips it through mid-wicket for a couple. The stand is worth 70 from 43 balls now.
Shadab Khan comes on to bowl his leg spin now.
Full and wide outside off, played through point for a run. 14 from the over, 30 off the last 2!
On middle and leg, Aaron tucks this straight to short fine leg and gets across for a quick single. The fielder misses his shy at the striker's end but Short would not have been short if that had hit.
FOUR! A length ball on middle and leg, Finch has a hack and the ball goes off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. Bats these days... the ball races away.

SIX! Another mistimed shot for a biggie! Ahh... luck luck luck. Finch comes down the track, Afridi bangs it short, the batsman looks to pull but gets a bit of a top edge. Mohammad Amir comes running in from fine leg but the ball sails over! Even if he had been at the ropes, he would not have taken that.
On middle and leg, Short looks to flick but the ball goes off his pads towards mid-wicket. A leg bye taken.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. One run added to the total.
The hero of the previous match - Shaheen Shah Afridi comes into the attack. In between overs, Mohammad Hafeez was with the drinks and a message for Sarfraz from the dressing room...
A yorker outside off. D'Arcy looks to squeeze it out to third man but misses. 16 from the final over of the Powerplay as Australia finish it on 54/0.

SIX! 50 UP FOR AUSTRALIA - Full of luck. The length is not full though on this occasion, it is short - just like Pakistan have been - short of luck. Short looks to pull but gets a top edge which sails beyond the keeper!
Another short ball, helped past short fine leg for a couple.
A long hop, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Another short ball, pulled towards deep square leg for a single this time.

SIX! The ball is up but Short is down. A short ball, down the leg side, D'Arcy pulls it and seems to mistime it. The ball hits the top half of the bat and sails over long leg. As soon as the shot was played, Short holds his ribs. Seems like he has overstretched himself. The stand moves to 44 from 31 balls. Short is onto 24 from 20 balls, with his first six.

TOP EDGE, SAFE AGAIN! A short ball, on middle, Finch looks to pull but gets a top edge. The keeper runs after it, so does short fine leg but the ball lands in between! There is a bit of a fumble and the batsmen come back for the second.
Pummels this towards mid on where substitute Mohammad Nawaz takes his eyes off the ball and fumbles. Concedes two.
Now comes the short ball, pulled away for a run.
A slow full toss down the leg side, D'Arcy misses it and the ball hits his pads.

LEADING EDGE? NOT TAKEN? Not sure. On a length, on middle and leg, Short looks to tuck it away to the leg side but is early into the shot and the ball lobs in the air towards the silly point region. Hasan Ali runs towards the ball but cannot get there. Replays do not seem to indicate any bat but cannot be totally sure...
FOUR! A poor start. A length ball, down the leg side, Short just helps it past the man in the ring on the leg side at 45. Easy boundary. The stand moves to 33 from 25 balls.
Hasan Ali into the attack now.

FOUR! ADMONISHED! First real worthy shot of a boundary. A short ball on middle, this time Mr. Finch waits for it and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket. There is a man in the deep but he can only run to retrieve the ball. Finch moves to 13 from 9 balls.
A short ball on off, Finch looks to pull but is beaten due to the lack of pace again.

A slower bouncer, around off, DAS looks to pull but misses due to the lack of pace. He is months early into the shot and the ball goes off his back to the off side. The short third man fielder comes running in but both batsmen take it lightly. Suddenly Finch realizes that he could be in trouble and hurriedly gets into the crease. But the fielder smartly throws it at the other end. 'WATCH IT, YOUR END!' shouts Finch. Short just about makes it even though the throw misses the stumps.
WIDE. A wide, wide ball way down the leg side, D'Arcy looks to pull but misses. Sarfraz Ahmed is the only one appealing for the catch, only to be responded with a wide signal.
On middle and off, angling away from over the wicket, Short looks to punch but gets a bottom edge back to the bowler.

On middle, Aaron punches this towards mid on who is snoozing. Suddenly he wakes up as there are shouts of 'MAAR DE, MAAR DE!' and he starts to run towards the ball. By the time he picks up the ball, the batsmen have already reached their respective ends after completing the single.
A short ball around off, Finch backs away and punches it straight to cover.
A short ball outside off, D'Arcy backs away and has a wild pull - only to miss.
Full and outside off, Aaron looks to push this by coming forward. But the ball bounces suddenly, hits the splice of the bat and lobs uppishly towards cover. A quick single taken.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad. They pick up a single. The umpire signals a leg bye.

MISFIELD, FOUR! A rare, rare  sight. Shoaib Malik not fielding the ball well. Full and outside off, Short throws the kitchen sink at this one, hammering it through mid off. Malik in that region moves slowly to his right, puts in a weak dive and as a result, is not able to stop the ball cleanly. He does take some pace off the ball but the power from Short is good enough to take it to the ropes. The stand moves to 20 from 15 balls.
Punches this through the covers and takes a quick single.
On a length outside off, placed beautifully behind point for a couple.

Gets across and looks to flick but an inside edge results. The ball deflects off his pads and the batsmen take a run. So Australia have got off to a great start - ONLY ACCORDING TO THE SCOREBOARD. Pakistan have been unlucky to be honest.
A short ball, Short looks to pull but the ball barely comes off the surface. He mistimes it over short fine leg and gets a single.
Cuts him into half now. This is pitched outside off, DAS looks to play but the ball comes back in a long way and squares him up. Just beats the outside edge and goes over the stumps.
A length ball on off, D'Arcy looks to loft this but mistimes it towards mid on.

DROPPED AGAIN? Ummm... don't think so. Faheem bowls this on a length around leg and it nips back in sharply. Short has nowhere to go as he looks to play some sort of a flick but before he can get his bat down, the ball is past him. Hits his pads and goes to Asif Ali at first slip who plonks it. There are shouts of 'CATCH IT!' initially and then an LBW appeal follows - negated.

DROPPED! A very, very difficult chance. But could have been taken had the communication lines been working between the fielders. A short ball outside off, Finch plays the pull shot but the bounce gets big on him. It goes high in the air, off the top edge and two fielders run after it - Mohammad Amir from fine leg and Shoaib Malik from mid-wicket. The latter gets to the ball, almost takes the catch as well - but from the corner of his eye, he probably sees Amir running in - that split second costs him and he puts the catch down. Three runs taken.
Here is Faheem Ashraf to bowl from the other end.
Similar line and length, watchfully pushed away. A really good over from Amir - the scorecard will not show that though. He has probed Short but the southpaw has gotten away with his wild swings.
On middle and leg, punched wide of mid on. Finch wants a run but is sent back.
Short fine leg in place along with a deep backward square leg.
Full and outside off, played a bit loosely, away from the body, straight to point.

FOUR! There is no tomorrow for Short. He is going after everything. A very good ball, landed on a length around off, coming in, Short wildly swings across the line and is comprehensively beaten. Luckily for him, the ball does not go through the yawning gap between bat and pad. It goes off the inner half of the bat and runs wide of mid on to the fence. Unlucky for the bowler. He was just one degree away from cutting Short's innings short.
On middle and leg, coming into the batsman, worked straight to short mid-wicket.

FOUR! Business straightaway. Short and outside off, not that wide but Short throws his bat at it. Is too close to the ball and hence gets an outside edge. But luckily for him, it flies wide of first slip and races to the third man fence.

The Aussie openers walk out to the middle. The drop in the previous match being short for Short, he is back to open alongside captain Finch. Mohammad Amir will start off proceedings to the 'comeback' kid...

The Pakistan team get into a huddle. Just a piece of information - the last time the Asian champions lost a T20I series - or let me rephrase it - DID NOT WIN A SERIES - was way back in 2016 - the WT20. They have won each and every T20I series since then - making it 8 in a row. Will today be the 9th?

PITCH LOOK - A few cracks on the surface, no grass, makes it perhaps an easy decision for the captains - willow should make the first use. This is the same track where Billy Stanlake ran through Pakistan in their first encounter - don't think we shall have that much bounce today.

TEAM NEWS - Surprising one for Australia. D'Arcy Short is back. He is given a longer rope. Nic Maddinson, who barely got any opportunity to prove himself, has been axed. Marcus Stoinis continues to be with the side. For Pakistan, they have brought back Hasan Ali, which is not a surprise - benching Usman Khan. After his 5/34 in an ODI against Sri Lanka in Sharjah in October 2017, Usman has barely made the headlines. Sahibzada Farhan makes his international debut, in place of Haris Sohail. A talented right-handed batsman is he - averaging 52.09 in List A cricket and close to 37 in T20s. The right-left combination at the top should come in handy for Pakistan, assuming Zaman and Farhan open.
National anthem time. Australia first up, followed by Pakistan's.
TOSS - Well, Aaron Finch has won one more toss. Given the slow nature of the pitches towards the dying stages of the tournament, it is not surprising that AUSTRALIA WILL BAT FIRST.
WEATHER - It was overcast for a couple of days in this series but today, it is nice and warm, bright and sunny. Hopefully, the conditions do not influence the game.

It has been 6 days of continuous T20 cricket and it is now time for the final. As expected before the start of the series, Australia clash against Pakistan for the trophy. Both teams honed their skills against an extremely weak Zimbabwean side and both units were more or less inconsistent. Which side will top today?
